title: Pre-project estimates
description: Pre-project offers before work exists. Not an invoice, not a sales CRM quote, not a change-order quote, and not billing or revenue until work is won and converted.
salesVsCrmBanner: Quotes are bids you send a customer. CRM is an optional sales pipeline - not a second quotes list.
disclaimer: This estimate is a commercial offer. It is not a statutory tax invoice.

hub.title: Estimates, changes, and billing
hub.description: Three separate documents - not one table. Pick the object you need.
hub.stripIntro: This is not a change request and not billing. CRM pipeline is a different object.
hub.preProjectBody: Priced bids before work exists. Not an invoice, not CRM, and not an in-project change.
hub.inProjectBody: Change requests and extras on an existing project. Not a sales estimate.
hub.billingBody: Invoices and collections after work exists. Not an estimate.
hub.crmNote: CRM is an optional sales pipeline. It is not the quotes book and not billing.
hub.salesDescription: Quotes (bids) are the customer offer. The sales pipeline is an optional CRM board.
hub.quotesBidsBody: Create, edit, issue (print/status), accept, and convert an estimate. Not billing.
hub.pipelineBody: Leads, prospects, and opportunities. Create the customer quote from Quotes.

empty.title: No estimates yet
empty.body: Create a priced offer for a client before winning the work. Acceptance can create a project or job - it does not bill.

create.title: New pre-project estimate
create.description: Mobile-friendly offer with line items, optional cost/margin preview, and VAT from your tax settings.
create.referenceHint: Leave blank to assign the next internal tracking number. This is not a tax invoice.
create.profitHint: Estimated cost and margin are a pre-win profitability preview - not Actual and not revenue.
create.discountHint: Customer discount on this estimate. Cost/margin is not a discount. Large discounts may need approval before sending.

detail.title: Pre-project estimate
detail.markSentHint: This records that the offer was issued to the customer (print or hand-off). It does not send email.
detail.sentIsNotEmail: Status is Issued. ProjectFlow did not send an email.
detail.convertHint: Creates a new project or job from this accepted estimate. Existing project changes still use Change Orders.

errors.invalidTransition: This status change is not allowed
errors.notEditable: Only draft or ready estimates can be edited
errors.useConvert: Use Convert to create a project or job
errors.notAccepted: Only an accepted estimate can be converted
errors.clientRequiredForJob: Choose a client before converting to a job
errors.quoteIsNotBilling: Pre-project estimates must not create billing records
